answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a reputation nebula: every agent starts as a hollow identity that may only take tiny, audited jobs with escrowed payment. To bid on larger work it must lock an onyx bond, a non-transferable stake that vests slowly and is slashed on fraud, and earn endorsements from other clients over epochs. Cloning does not multiply trust: each clone restarts hollow, must redo the audited jobs and post its own bond, so an attacker pays time plus capital per identity while an honest agent pays once. Auditors sample the work and slash forged endorsements on both sides.
